checks: Unauthenticated pages show login; protected model/run/account APIs reject requests; 390px login has no overflow
Console-issued temporary administrator password must be changed before entering the workspace
Admin UI issues two normal accounts and shows passwords once; both users must change them; account identity is read-only and admin navigation is hidden
Browser saves preserve authenticated owners; each model list, count and direct ID lookup exposes only its own model
UI calculation and concurrent submissions complete three real ngspice jobs with 2/3 divider voltages; foreign histories/CSV/packages are denied and admin access succeeds
Admin model-list assignment reveals unassigned models only to the chosen user; transferring ownership also transfers immutable run-history access
Changing a personal password rotates the session and preserves unsaved edits; modal keyboard shortcuts do not duplicate underlying components
Admin password reset revokes an existing browser session; its next operation returns to login and the new temporary password must be changed
Admin role changes and deactivation revoke prior sessions; reactivation permits a fresh login with current permissions
At 390px, normal model lists and administrator account controls are usable without horizontal page overflow
Deleting an account immediately removes login access while models and successful calculation histories remain available to administrators
Concurrent cross-deactivation of the final two administrators is serialized by PostgreSQL; one remains active and self-deletion is refused
